items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: WWD reports Gucci is restructuring into business units, with industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini joining as senior advisers based in Italy, working alongside creative director Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini as the house continues its operational turnaround push.

items.title: Kering Q3 2026: Revenues Flat as Gucci Misses Forecasts
items.summary: Kering's Q3 2026 revenue was flat at EUR3.35bn, but Gucci missed analyst expectations with sales down 6% comparable (vs 5.4% expected); Gucci retail sales fell 9% on weak traffic in China/Japan, while North America was the most resilient region for the house.

items.title: RBC Cuts Kering Forecasts After Gucci Misses Expectations
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets lowered its Q4 Gucci retail growth forecast to -5% (from -1%) and trimmed 2026 group growth estimates following Gucci's Q3 sales miss; Berenberg separately cut its price target to EUR165, underscoring analyst skepticism about the pace of Gucci's turnaround under Demna.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Roundup of TikTok and social comments reacting negatively to Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey; viewers called the ad 'cold,' 'emotionless' and 'outdated,' with one comment comparing it to 'if JCPenney was trying to be luxury.' No numeric engagement figures given.

items.title: Mariah Carey for Gucci's Holiday 2026 Ad Campaign
items.summary: Fashion-commentary blog covers the Harmony Korine-directed 'Gucci Gift' holiday film starring Mariah Carey, introducing the Butterfly collection; piece notes the campaign's deliberately eerie, hotel-set tone set to 'All I Want for Christmas Is You.'

items.title: Gucci official X account posts GucciCore/Cruise-era imagery; public reply threads mixed on AI-aesthetic fatigue
items.summary: Gucci's official X account continues posting campaign and show imagery; reply threads under recent Gucci posts show continued public commentary split between admiration for star casting and fatigue/criticism toward the brand's heavy reliance on celebrity spectacle over product storytelling.

items.source: TikTok (public comments, aggregated via press coverage)
items.title: TikTok commenters call Gucci holiday ad 'sterile' and lacking Christmas warmth
items.summary: Public TikTok comments under the Gucci holiday campaign video (captured via press roundup) include direct quotes such as 'It feels like an episode of AHS' and 'Nothing about Gucci feels luxe to me anymore,' reflecting a vein of brand-fatigue sentiment distinct from the campaign's intended festive tone.

items.title: Gucci price increase thread *please state location* (ongoing)
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum community thread where US/Canada members log and discuss Gucci price increases by bag model (Marmont, Soho Disco, Horsebit 1955, Dionysus WOC); recurring theme is frustration that price hikes have outpaced perceived quality/design payoff. Thread remains active with posts as recent as August 2026; exact newest-post date not confirmed via search snippet, flagged as older anchor thread rather than a fresh daily post.

items.title: Forum Buzz: Alex Consani, Gabrriette & Others Front Demna's 'Trash' 2026 Generation Gucci Campaign
items.summary: theFashionSpot's forum-buzz desk (aggregating fashion-forum member reaction) covers a Demna-era Gucci campaign fronted by Alex Consani and Gabrriette; community commentary is mixed, with some praising the model casting and others continuing to question the direction's coherence under Demna.

items.title: Parker Posey in Gucci Dress at LACMA Gala 2026
items.summary: Gucci sponsored the LACMA Art+Film Gala in Los Angeles on November 7, 2026 (600+ guests, record ~$7M raised); Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini attended with numerous celebrities dressed by the house including Kim Kardashian, Timothee Chalamet, Sarah Paulson and Viola Davis, reinforcing Gucci's Hollywood red-carpet visibility in the NA market.

items.title: Demna Gets That Gucci Is Defined by the Culture
items.summary: Older Hypebeast feature on Demna's cultural read of Gucci's codes; included as background context for the brand's ongoing culture-first strategy narrative, but flagged as stale (outside the 14-day freshness window) and not counted toward today's buzz weighting.

items.title: Kering's Gucci Turnaround Looks Further Away, Berenberg Says
items.summary: Berenberg analyst note argues Gucci's turnaround trajectory is slower than hoped, citing continued traffic weakness; cut 2026-2028 sales and EPS assumptions and lowered its (sell-rated) price target to EUR165 from EUR175.
